description.en: Creates a light (Low) model from the event character table: CMND_CREATE_CHARA(8, _charaName, _id, "dmy", false, _base, _mem). The table gives the character (para_cp or cn number) and the kit; an unknown ID gives 0. No shipped script calls it.
Name of the new object; the events use the character's name followed by L (light model) or H (detailed model).
Handle of the new character, 0 if the ID is unknown.

examples.case: A character from the event table (not found in script_clean/; invented)
